content.text:
I found a likely second cause and patched it. I can't confirm it works: I can't run the app here, and TypeScript isn't installed in the project, so the changes haven't even been type-checked.

**What I think is happening:** when a mode is active (Team Meet, Sales, Recruiting, etc.), the end-of-meeting recap doesn't use the general action-items list my last fix changed. It fills that mode's own sections instead. Several of those sections are described as "All action items that were said **I** would do", which only covers your own tasks. So "Priya will send the contract" was likely dropped because it's Priya's task. The missing deadline probably wasn't the reason.

**What I changed:**
- **`electron/MeetingPersistence.ts`:** when the recap prompt is built, any section that looks like an action-item section (titles containing "Action items", "Follow-up", "Next steps", "Tasks" and similar) now gets an added rule. It says to include every task with an owner, whether that's you or anyone else in the meeting, and to write "(no date given)" when there's no deadline. Your modes keep their own saved copy of these descriptions, so I added this rule at the point the prompt is built rather than relying on the template alone.
- **`electron/services/ModesManager.ts`:** the default Team Meet "Action Items" description now covers everyone's tasks, not just yours.

**Trade-off:** this also widens the Sales and Recruiting action sections, which were written to list only your own tasks. They'll now include other people's tasks too. I can limit the change to Team Meet and General if you'd prefer.

**To test:** end a meeting in the mode you normally use, where someone says something like "Priya will send the contract" with no date. If it's still missing, tell me which mode you were in and which AI provider you use (Groq, Gemini, a custom provider, etc.), since each of those uses a slightly different prompt.
